summary_en: Tosoh Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 12.0 million shares (3.90% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 25.0 billion yen through November 6, 2026 to March 31, 2027 via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Tosoh Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as read in conjunction with Article 165. The company will acquire up to 12.0 million shares of common stock, representing 3.90% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026, when 308,024,527 shares were outstanding), for a maximum aggregate purchase price of 25.0 billion yen.

The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-hour trading transactions (ToSTNeT-3), between November 6, 2026 and March 31, 2027. The company stated the purpose of the acquisition is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
